'''Checkpoint Gamma''' was an Imperial checkpoint that was set up in [[Ahdjok]], the capital city of [[Nizon]], by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The Imperials set up the checkpoint across a wide street, during the [[Battle of Nizon]]. They built two 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] high [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferroconcrete]] barricades, with a gap in the middle that was guarded by three [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]]. It was a serious obstacle to the [[Nizon resistance]], as it prevented their two largest groups from connecting. A team of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents attacked it, to try and help them break through.
